mechanism_narrative: A sharp and persistent increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% for two consecutive months signals central bank over-tightening, which raises real discount rates and reduces expected equity valuations, thereby depressing near-term S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains > 0.3% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: accelerating inflation in a restrictive policy regime
failure_condition: Over the 20-day horizon, S&P 500 forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-inflation spike mean (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL reverts below 0.3% within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month, the expected future discount rate increases, lowering the present value of expected corporate cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25pp in a single month
regime_hint: normalizing or tightening monetary policy cycle
failure_condition: Rank IC for the 60-day window exceeds 0.05, or S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative relative to the pre-move mean (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS of at least 2,000 jobs for three consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥ 2,000 in three consecutive months
failure_condition: Over the 5-day horizon, forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.10), or the labor momentum reverses in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO of at least 5 points in a single month, following a prior month of expansion, suggests a supply shock that reduces production capacity, lowering growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by ≥ 5 points after a prior month of ≥ 1-point increase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.15), or INDPRO recovers within two months.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST falls by more than 100 units in a month, it signals weakening demand for big-ticket durable goods, which compresses earnings growth forecasts and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by > 100 units in a single month
failure_condition: Rank IC for 60-day window > 0.07, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both PAYEMS and UNRATE above their 12-month averages by at least 1 percentage point each indicate a labor market that is simultaneously expanding and more expensive, which can create wage-stiffening effects and reduce corporate profit expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-mo avg + 1pp AND UNRATE > 12-mo avg + 1pp in the same month
regime_hint: labor market expansion with rising wage inflation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.15), or either proxy reverts to below its 12-month average in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS of at least 10 million dollars for two consecutive months signals a loss of market confidence in credit availability, which raises risk premia and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by ≥ 10 million for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.10), or RSAFS recovers within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls by at least 0.2 percentage points for three consecutive months in a context of weak GDP growth, it suggests easing labor market pressures and a return to supply-side constraints, which can lift near-term earnings expectations and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by ≥ 0.2pp for three consecutive months AND GDP growth < 1% in the prior quarter
regime_hint: labor market easing in a weak growth environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10), or UNRATE resumes upward trend within two months.
